country_profile.government_type: Islamic Emirate (Taliban de facto government since August 2021; internationally unrecognised)

ethnic_groups.name: Pashtun
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest group; south and east; Pashto-speaking; tribal confederations: Durrani (Abdali) and Ghilzai; Pashtunwali code; historically ruling elite; cross-border with Pakistan (FATA/KPK); Taliban predominantly Pashtun

ethnic_groups.name: Tajik
ethnic_groups.notes: Dari-speaking; north and west; Panjshir, Herat, Kabul; Northern Alliance core; Ahmad Shah Massoud's group; urban professionals; Sunni

ethnic_groups.name: Hazara
ethnic_groups.notes: Central highlands (Hazarajat/Bamiyan); Mongol features; Shia Muslim; historically persecuted; Dari-speaking; targeted by Taliban

ethnic_groups.name: Uzbek
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern provinces (Faryab, Jowzjan, Sar-e Pol); Turkic; Abdul Rashid Dostum's group; horse culture; buzkashi

ethnic_groups.name: Aimaq
ethnic_groups.notes: Western/central highlands; semi-nomadic; Dari-speaking; Chahar Aimaq (four tribes): Taimani, Firozkohi, Jamshidi, Hazara-e Aimaq

ethnic_groups.name: Turkmen
ethnic_groups.notes: Northwest (Faryab, Badghis); Turkic; carpet weaving; cross-border with Turkmenistan

ethnic_groups.name: Baloch
ethnic_groups.notes: Southwest (Nimroz, Helmand); cross-border with Pakistan and Iran; Balochi-speaking; pastoral

ethnic_groups.name: Nuristani
ethnic_groups.notes: Nuristan province; last to convert to Islam (1896, formerly 'Kafiristan'); Indo-Aryan languages; mountain people

ethnic_groups.name: Pashai
ethnic_groups.notes: Eastern Afghanistan (Laghman, Nangarhar); Indo-Aryan Pashai language; mountain valleys

ethnic_groups.name: Other (Qizilbash, Brahui, Pamiri, etc.)
ethnic_groups.notes: Qizilbash (Shia, Kabul, historically bureaucratic class); Brahui; Pamiri; Gujars; Jat; Kuchi (nomadic Pashtuns ~2.5M)

independence.from: United Kingdom (Treaty of Rawalpindi; full sovereignty)

country_profile.national_motto: There is no god but God; Muhammad is the messenger of God (Shahada)
country_profile.national_anthem: Dā Watan dā Ṭolō Afghānānō Kor Dey (This is the Home of All Afghans)

geography.terrain: Mostly rugged mountains; Hindu Kush ranges; plains in north and southwest
geography.notes: Landlocked crossroads of Central and South Asia; Wakhan Corridor connects to China; Hindu Kush dominates; rich mineral deposits largely untapped.

economy_extended.notes: Economy collapsed post-Taliban takeover Aug 2021; $9B+ in central bank reserves frozen; sanctions regime; opium/heroin economy historically 10-15% of GDP; severe humanitarian crisis; banking system near-non-functional.

health.notes: Healthcare system devastated by decades of conflict; polio endemic (one of two remaining countries); Taliban banned women health workers; NGO-dependent healthcare delivery.

food_agriculture.notes: World's largest opium producer (80%+ global supply pre-Taliban ban); pomegranates and saffron are key legal export crops; severe drought risk; subsistence farming dominant; Taliban poppy ban 2022 disrupted millions of rural livelihoods.

energy.notes: Heavily dependent on energy imports from neighbouring countries (Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Iran); hydropower potential enormous (23 GW) but only 600 MW developed; biomass/firewood main rural energy; TAPI gas pipeline planned.

transport.notes: Landlocked; road network damaged by decades of war; Ring Road (Highway 1) critical artery; Salang Tunnel key north-south link; no significant railway network; Kabul International Airport main gateway.

tourism.notes: Tourism virtually non-existent under Taliban rule; Bamiyan Buddhas destroyed 2001; Minaret of Jam and Bamiyan Valley on UNESCO World Heritage List; extreme security risks preclude tourism development.

legal_system.notes: Taliban imposed strict Sharia interpretation since Aug 2021; women barred from courts/legal profession; tribal jirgas still resolve disputes in rural areas; no functional constitution since 2021 takeover.

human_rights_gender.notes: Worst country in the world for women's rights under Taliban; girls banned from secondary/university education; women barred from most employment, parks, gyms; mandatory face covering; male guardian required for travel.

security_stability.notes: Under Taliban control since Aug 2021; IS-K (Islamic State Khorasan) active insurgency; ongoing resistance in Panjshir Valley; world's largest IDP population; massive landmine/UXO contamination.

cultural_heritage.notes: Crossroads of civilisations (Gandharan Buddhist, Persian, Turkic, Mongol); Rumi, the most-read poet in English, born in Balkh; rich carpet-weaving tradition; Buzkashi national sport.

comparative_rankings.notes: Consistently at or near bottom of most global rankings; humanitarian crisis largest in the world.
